say:2:1010626001:0.source_cn: ——等一下，我还没记下手势和咒语！您能再演示一遍吗？！

say:3:1010626002:0.text: And that, everyone, is the <style="highlight">power of Merlin</style>.

say:4:1010626003:0.text: I can sense a faint stirring deep within the earth. A heart that should have stopped beating long ago has begun to pulse with new vitality.
say:4:1010626003:0.source_cn: 我能感觉到，地脉深处隐隐传来和暖的鼓动。就像枯朽之人的...

say:7:1010626004:0.text: Does that mean the seal has been mended? Will the cold weather finally go back to normal?
say:7:1010626004:0.source_cn: 这样封印就恢复了？那突降的气温还能恢复吗？

say:8:1010626005:0.text: In a matter of days, yes. This land needs some time to heal. As the cold, stiff earth regains consciousness, warmth and vitality will return once more.
say:8:1010626005:0.source_cn: 假以时日，会的。给这片土地一些时间，等它冷僵的躯体慢慢...

say:9:1010626006:0.source_cn: 谢天谢地，终于告一段落了。

say:10:1010626007:0.text: We should go back and report everything to General Hogan. It looks like I'll have a lot of paperwork to do...
say:10:1010626007:0.source_cn: 也该回去向霍根将军禀告事件详情了，唉，还有好多文书要写……

say:11:1010626008:0.source_cn: 等等，是不是少了一个人？
